notes_for_editor: Source conflict. tnlandforms places Braden Mountain in Campbell County (2,700 ft, code 2-22, moved). The Encyclopedia of Scott County lists a Braden Mountain tower above Rock House Creek that was reassembled at View Tree Knob and no longer remains. Not confirmed whether these are the same tower, and the record's Campbell County may or may not be right. If the Scott County account is right, the record's relocated status understates the loss; left for a human to decide. Worth checking the 1976 Division of Forestry tower list and the 2015 Division of Forestry study for county and destination. The tnlandforms m.php?wpt=CAT001 page returns gambling spam, so it was not used.
